# sdwan_policy_object_security_rule_set (Data Source)

This data source can read the Policy Object Security Rule Set Policy_object.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sdwan_policy_object_security_rule_set" "example" {
  id                 = "f6b2c44c-693c-4763-b010-895aa3d236bd"
  feature_profile_id = "f6dd22c8-0b4f-496c-9a0b-6813d1f8b8ac"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `feature_profile_id` (String) Feature Profile ID

### Optional

- `id` (String) The id of the Policy_object
- `name` (String) The name of the Policy_object

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the Policy_object
- `sequences` (Attributes List) select definition of rule (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sequences))
- `version` (Number) The version of the Policy_object
